How should qualified matches for this PO: How should qualified matches for this POD be handled?
Automatic mode places qualified candidat: Automatic mode places qualified candidates directly in the Outer Circle of this published POD, without asking you first. They get Outer Circle access to the POD workspace. Nobody is ever moved to the Inner Circle automatically.
A match qualifies when the candidate mee: A match qualifies when the candidate meets every mandatory criterion and scores at least this much (a score equal to it qualifies). Qualified matches are only acted on once the POD is published. Changing the mode or score re-checks existing matches; it never removes or demotes members.
The matching mode and minimum match scor: The matching mode and minimum match score preselect every new POD (Manual starts as Recommend only, Assisted as pending approval, Automatic as automatic Outer Circle placement). Each POD keeps its own copy: changing these defaults never updates existing PODs. Left empty, new PODs use :default.
Only the criteria you configure are scor: Only the criteria you configure are scored. Configured criteria are optional unless you tick them as mandatory: optional criteria only raise or lower the match score, while a mandatory criterion that is not met disqualifies the candidate whatever their score. Work mode and engagement type never change the score; they only disqualify when mandatory.
